raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

With `--step-batch-size-schedule` and `--save` set, the training loop saves a checkpoint and exits when the global batch size steps up, so the run can be relaunched at the new size. It detected the step only when the number of microbatches changed. The unchecked update rounds that number down, so a new global batch size that the data-parallel size does not divide left it unchanged: 8192 → 12288 at `micro_batch_size` 1 and data-parallel size 8192 gives 1 microbatch both before and after. The step went undetected, and the consistency check right after it crashed the job without saving:

```
AssertionError: current global batch size (12288) is not divisible by micro_batch_size (1) * data_parallel_size (8192)
```

With a step batch-size schedule set, the loop now also tracks the global batch size and treats a change in either value as a step. The comparison is limited to the schedule because RL without sequence packing resizes the global batch every step. The "should not decrease" assertion checks the global batch size instead of the number of microbatches. The RL sequence-packing path, which skips the save, is unchanged.

On relaunch, the load-time consistency check still rejects a configuration whose `micro_batch_size × data_parallel_size` does not divide the new batch size.

## Testing

Not run. The path is exercised only by a training run that crosses a schedule step; the change is confined to the step-detection condition in `train()`.

Running `test_workload_inspector_uses_profiling_config` in isolation now fails before its expected `BeforeTrainStep` exception. Its [`inline_profiler` fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/f7902b8ed8926d2e89ad5b5a27a26ed2f7260580/tests/unit_tests/training/test_profiling_ownership.py#L53-L111) mocks `get_num_microbatches()` but neither initializes the calculator nor mocks this getter. The [real getter](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/f7902b8ed8926d2e89ad5b5a27a26ed2f7260580/megatron/core/num_microbatches_calculator.py#L12-L24) dereferences the initially `None` calculator, producing `AttributeError`. The base preamble did not make this call. This is a source-derived failure, not an executed test result.

In `inline_profiler`, beside its existing microbatch-getter mock, add `monkeypatch.setattr(training, "get_current_global_batch_size", lambda: 1)`. This keeps the fixture independent of unrelated calculator initialization without weakening production validation or leaking global state.

Proposed acceptance checks: with the calculator unset, both `enabled` cases must reach the fixture's expected sentinel and retain the server/thread start assertions. Run the [profiling-ownership tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/f7902b8ed8926d2e89ad5b5a27a26ed2f7260580/tests/unit_tests/training/test_profiling_ownership.py#L280-L368) through the documented distributed pytest runner; retain the nsys start/stop counts of `int(expected)` and the PyTorch resume cases' exactly-once `start`, `step`, and `stop` assertions. Please verify the suggested fixture change before adopting it.

[P3] Add a regression test for the training-loop transition decision

This bug fix adds no regression test. The existing [schedule tests](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/f7902b8ed8926d2e89ad5b5a27a26ed2f7260580/tests/unit_tests/test_num_microbatches_calculator.py#L136-L205) exercise calculator behavior, not checkpoint/exit ordering. Removing the new comparison would therefore leave those assertions passing while restoring the reported failure: an unchanged rounded microbatch count reaches consistency validation without saving.

Add a focused mocked `train()` test under the [training unit-test directory](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/tree/f7902b8ed8926d2e89ad5b5a27a26ed2f7260580/tests/unit_tests/training), using `run_config` and monkeypatch conventions. Minimal setup: microbatch size 1, logical DP size 8, sequence length 1, schedule `0:8 8:12`; initialize the calculator at batch size 8, then enter the loop at completed iteration 1 with 8 consumed samples, saving enabled and packing disabled. Exercise the production branch, not a copied predicate. Assert exactly one checkpoint at iteration 1, exit before another `train_step`, and no checked update at batch size 12. The [base condition](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/e3f528380c197e8811fb68064d9ef3acf59fd3c6/megatron/training/training.py#L5114-L5152) should fail this test.

Preservation checks should distinguish these cases: divisible scheduled growth `8 → 16` still saves/exits; invalid `8 → 12` without saving still raises the divisibility assertion without checkpointing; iteration zero does not automatically save; an unscheduled RL global-size-only change with unchanged microbatch count does not save; sequence packing bypasses automatic saving and the monotonic assertion when its microbatch count decreases. Retain the existing calculator assertions accepting undersized past entries and rejecting an invalid current entry.

These are proposed tests, not executed results. The surrounding mocked-loop harness needs author integration; its invariant should explicitly protect both transition detection and saving before validation or further training.

+def is_batch_size_transition(
+    num_microbatches: int, global_batch_size: int, has_step_batch_size_schedule: bool

+    """Return whether the last unchecked microbatch update moved to a new batch size.

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Checks for the training loop's batch-size schedule transition decision."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from megatron.core.num_microbatches_calculator import (
+    destroy_num_microbatches_calculator,
+    get_current_global_batch_size,
+    get_num_microbatches,
+    init_num_microbatches_calculator,
+    update_num_microbatches,
+)
+from megatron.training.training import is_batch_size_transition
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def step_schedule():
+    """Start a step schedule at global batch size 8 with one sample per data-parallel rank."""
+
+    def start(schedule):
+        init_num_microbatches_calculator(
+            rank=0, micro_batch_size=1, data_parallel_size=8, step_batch_size_schedule=schedule
+        )
+        return get_num_microbatches(), get_current_global_batch_size()
+
+    yield start
+    destroy_num_microbatches_calculator()
+
+
+def test_transition_detected_when_rounded_microbatch_count_is_unchanged(step_schedule):
+    num_microbatches, global_batch_size = step_schedule("0:8 8:12")
+    update_num_microbatches(8, consistency_check=False)
+    # The unchecked update rounds 12 / 8 down to the old count of one microbatch.
+    assert get_num_microbatches() == num_microbatches
+    assert get_current_global_batch_size() == 12
+    assert is_batch_size_transition(num_microbatches, global_batch_size, True)
+    # The consistency check that follows would reject 12 at data-parallel size 8.
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        update_num_microbatches(8, consistency_check=True)
+
+
+def test_transition_detected_on_divisible_schedule_step(step_schedule):
+    num_microbatches, global_batch_size = step_schedule("0:8 8:16")
+    update_num_microbatches(8, consistency_check=False)
+    assert get_num_microbatches() == 2
+    assert is_batch_size_transition(num_microbatches, global_batch_size, True)
+    assert is_batch_size_transition(num_microbatches, global_batch_size, False)
+
+
+def test_no_transition_before_schedule_step(step_schedule):
+    num_microbatches, global_batch_size = step_schedule("0:8 8:12")
+    update_num_microbatches(4, consistency_check=False)
+    assert not is_batch_size_transition(num_microbatches, global_batch_size, True)
+
+
+def test_global_batch_size_ignored_without_step_schedule(step_schedule):
+    num_microbatches, global_batch_size = step_schedule("0:8 8:12")
+    update_num_microbatches(8, consistency_check=False)
+    # RL without sequence packing resizes the global batch every step without a schedule.
+    assert not is_batch_size_transition(num_microbatches, global_batch_size, False)
